kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننخرم (form VII)
# نَنْخَرِمُ (nanḵarimu) /nan.xa.ri.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# نَنْخَرِمَ (nanḵarima) /nan.xa.ri.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# نَنْخَرِمْ (nanḵarim) /nan.xa.rim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
